content: {"sql": "SELECT name AS 厂站, kind AS 类型, capacity_m3d AS 设计规模_m3_d FROM plant WHERE process = '氧化沟' ORDER BY id", "explanation": "从 plant 表中筛选处理工艺为氧化沟的厂站，列出名称、类型和设计规模。"}
{"sql": "SELECT count(*) AS 鼓风机总数, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = '备用') AS 备用台数 FROM device WHERE kind = '鼓风机'", "explanation": "统计设备台账中类型为鼓风机的总台数，并按状态筛选出备用台数。"}
{"sql": "SELECT name AS 厂站, process AS 工艺, capacity_m3d AS 设计规模_m3_d FROM plant WHERE kind = '集镇厂' ORDER BY capacity_m3d DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "从 plant 表中筛选集镇厂，按设计规模降序取第一条即可得到规模最大的集镇厂。"}
{"sql": "SELECT name AS 厂站, capacity_m3d AS 设计处理规模_m3_d FROM plant WHERE name LIKE '%南郑中心%'", "explanation": "按厂站名称模糊匹配南郑中心污水处理厂，直接查询 plant 表中的设计处理规模字段。"}
{"sql": "SELECT kind AS 设备类型, count(*) AS 设备数量, round(sum(rated_kw)::numeric, 1) AS 总额定功率_kW FROM device GROUP BY kind ORDER BY 设备数量 DESC", "explanation": "按设备类型分组统计 device 表的设备数量与额定功率之和。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, d.kind AS 设备类型, d.model AS 型号, d.rated_kw AS 额定功率_kW, d.status AS 状态 FROM device d JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%梁山%' ORDER BY d.code LIMIT 100", "explanation": "按厂站名称模糊匹配梁山镇污水处理站，关联设备台账列出设备编码、类型等信息。"}
{"sql": "SELECT sum(capacity_m3d) AS 设计规模合计_m3_d, count(*) AS 厂站数 FROM plant", "explanation": "对 plant 表所有厂站的设计处理规模求和并统计厂站数量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, r.ts AS 时间, round(r.inflow_m3h::numeric, 1) AS 进水流量_m3h FROM plant_reading r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND r.ts > now() - interval '30 minutes' ORDER BY r.ts DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "查询中心厂最近半小时内最新一条原始实时数据的进水瞬时流量，取时间倒序第一条作为当前值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, d.kind AS 类型, d.model AS 型号, d.rated_kw AS 额定功率_kw, d.status AS 状态 FROM device d JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE d.rated_kw = (SELECT max(rated_kw) FROM device) ORDER BY d.code", "explanation": "先取全表最大额定功率，再筛出功率等于该最大值的设备并关联厂站名称。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, r.ts AS 时间, round(r.mlss::numeric, 0) AS 污泥浓度MLSS FROM plant_reading r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' AND r.ts > now() - interval '2 hours' ORDER BY r.ts DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "按厂站名称模糊匹配协税镇，取最近2小时内最新一条实时数据的 MLSS 值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.id) p.name AS 厂站, r.ts AS 时间, round(r.do_aerobic_1::numeric, 2) AS 好氧区1号DO, round(r.do_aerobic_2::numeric, 2) AS 好氧区2号DO FROM plant_reading r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.ts > now() - interval '30 minutes' ORDER BY p.id, r.ts DESC", "explanation": "取每个厂站最近30分钟内最新一条实时数据的两个好氧区溶解氧值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h h WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now())", "explanation": "统计昨天（前一个自然日）全区所有厂站小时进水流量之和即为总处理水量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.id) p.name AS 厂站, r.ts AS 时间, round(r.tn_out::numeric, 2) AS 出水总氮_mgL FROM plant_reading r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.ts > now() - interval '30 minutes' AND r.tn_out IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p.id, r.ts DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "取最近30分钟内各厂站最新一条实时数据的出水总氮，按厂站去重后取总氮最高的一条。"}

{"sql": "SELECT d.code AS 设备编码, r.ts AS 时间, round(r.current_a::numeric, 1) AS 电流_A, r.running AS 是否运行 FROM device_reading r JOIN device d ON d.id = r.device_id WHERE d.code = 'P01-BL-1' AND r.ts > now() - interval '30 minutes' ORDER BY r.ts DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "取鼓风机 P01-BL-1 最近 30 分钟内最新一条设备监测记录的运行电流。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(sum(h.blower_kw)::numeric, 1) AS 鼓风机耗电量_kWh FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.name", "explanation": "筛选中心厂昨天的 1 小时均值数据，用 sum(blower_kw) 汇总鼓风机耗电量（kWh）。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(coalesce(sum(h.inflow_m3h), 0)::numeric, 0) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant p LEFT JOIN plant_reading_1h h ON h.plant_id = p.id AND h.hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY 2 DESC", "explanation": "以厂站为主表左连接本周（date_trunc('week', now()) 起）的小时数据，汇总各厂处理水量，无数据的厂站显示 0。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(h.nh3n_in)::numeric, 2) AS 平均进水氨氮_mgL, count(*) AS 小时数 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id", "explanation": "按厂站对最近24小时 plant_reading_1h 的进水氨氮小时均值再取平均，并统计参与计算的小时数。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round((sum(h.inflow_m3h) / 6)::numeric, 0) AS 平均日处理水量_m3, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 0) AS 期间总处理水量_m3, count(DISTINCT date_trunc('day', h.hour)) AS 天数 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%梁山%' AND h.hour >= timestamptz '2026-10-30 00:00:00+08' AND h.hour < timestamptz '2026-11-05 00:00:00+08'", "explanation": "筛选梁山镇污水站 10月30日至11月4日（6个自然日）的小时处理水量求和，再除以 6 得到日均处理水量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(h.cod_in)::numeric, 1) AS 进水COD平均值_mgL FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) + interval '6 hours' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) + interval '12 hours' GROUP BY p.id, p.name", "explanation": "筛选中心厂今日 6:00-12:00 的小时均值数据，对进水 COD 取平均。"}

{"sql":"SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(h.cod_out)::numeric, 2) AS 出水COD日均值, round(avg(h.nh3n_out)::numeric, 2) AS 出水氨氮日均值, round(avg(h.tn_out)::numeric, 2) AS 出水总氮日均值, round(avg(h.tp_out)::numeric, 3) AS 出水总磷日均值 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.kind = '中心厂' AND h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.id, p.name","explanation":"筛选中心厂昨天整天的数据，按小时表求各项出水指标的日均值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(sum(h.blower_kw)::numeric, 1) AS 鼓风机总耗电量_kWh, round((sum(h.blower_kw) / nullif(sum(h.inflow_m3h), 0))::numeric, 4) AS 吨水曝气电耗_kWh FROM plant_reading_1h h WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now())", "explanation": "汇总昨天（前一个自然日）全部厂站的小时鼓风机功率得到总耗电量，再除以同期处理水量得到吨水曝气电耗。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(sum(h.carbon_dose_kgh)::numeric, 1) AS 碳源投加量_kg, round(sum(h.pac_dose_kgh)::numeric, 1) AS PAC投加量_kg FROM plant_reading_1h h WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('week', now())", "explanation": "汇总本周（周一起）所有厂站小时表的碳源与PAC投加量。"}

{"sql":"SELECT round(max(temp_c)::numeric, 1) AS 最高气温, round(min(temp_c)::numeric, 1) AS 最低气温 FROM weather WHERE ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND ts < date_trunc('day', now())","explanation":"统计昨天自然日全天区域气象数据中的最高和最低气温。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(h.air_flow_m3h)::numeric, 1) AS 平均曝气风量_m3h FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.name", "explanation": "取中心厂昨天全天的小时均值数据，对曝气总风量求平均。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(r.mlss)::numeric, 1) AS 平均污泥浓度_mgL, count(*) AS 样本数 FROM plant_reading r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.ts >= now() - interval '7 days' AND r.mlss IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id", "explanation": "MLSS 仅存在于分钟级原始表 plant_reading（小时聚合表无该字段），故对最近 7 天原始数据按厂站求平均污泥浓度。"}

{"sql": "SELECT h.hour AS 时间, round(avg(h.tp_out)::numeric, 3) AS 出水总磷均值
FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id
WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%'
  AND h.hour >= timestamptz '2026-11-03 00:00:00+08'
  AND h.hour <  timestamptz '2026-11-04 00:00:00+08'
GROUP BY h.hour
ORDER BY h.hour", "explanation": "按协税镇筛选11月3日当天的小时数据，逐小时对出水总磷求均值"}

{"sql":"SELECT h.hour AS 时间, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 1) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h h WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) AND h.hour < now() GROUP BY h.hour ORDER BY h.hour","explanation":"筛选今日零点起的1小时聚合数据，按整点分组汇总各厂站处理水量，得到全区每小时处理水量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(h.cod_out)::numeric, 2) AS 平均出水COD_mgL FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "统计最近7天各厂出水COD小时均值，按平均值降序取最高的厂站。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric) AS 处理水量_m3
FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id
WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day'
  AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now())
GROUP BY p.name
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 3", "explanation": "统计昨天各厂站小时处理水量之和并降序取前三。"}

{"sql": "SELECT time_bucket('1 day', h.hour, 'Asia/Shanghai')::date AS 日期, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 0) AS 处理水量_m3, round(sum(h.blower_kw)::numeric, 1) AS 鼓风机耗电量_kWh, round((sum(h.blower_kw) / nullif(sum(h.inflow_m3h), 0))::numeric, 4) AS 吨水曝气电耗_kWh FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.code = 'P01' AND h.hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) AND h.hour < now() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1", "explanation": "按天汇总中心厂本周小时表的鼓风机耗电量与处理水量，两者相除得到每天的吨水曝气电耗。"}

{"sql": "SELECT date_trunc('day', ts)::date AS 日期, round(avg(temp_c)::numeric, 1) AS 平均气温_℃ FROM weather WHERE ts >= date_trunc('month', now()) AND ts < date_trunc('month', now()) + interval '4 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1", "explanation": "按天统计11月1日至4日气象数据中的平均气温"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round((sum(h.carbon_dose_kgh) / NULLIF(sum(h.inflow_m3h), 0))::numeric, 6) AS 吨水碳源投加量_kg_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY 2 DESC", "explanation": "近7天按厂站汇总碳源投加量（carbon_dose_kgh 之和）与处理水量（inflow_m3h 之和），两者相除得到吨水碳源投加量，并按该值从高到低排序。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, count(*) AS 超标小时数, round(max(h.nh3n_out_max)::numeric, 3) AS 最高氨氮, round(avg(h.nh3n_out_max)::numeric, 3) AS 平均氨氮 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' AND h.nh3n_out_max > 5 GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id", "explanation": "统计最近7天各厂小时出水氨氮最大值超过一级A标准5 mg/L的小时数，并列出最高与平均氨氮浓度。"}

{"sql": "SELECT date_trunc('day', h.hour)::date AS 日期, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric) AS 处理水量_m3
FROM plant_reading_1h h
WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '7 days'
  AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now())
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 1", "explanation": "按自然日汇总过去 7 个完整日全区所有厂站的处理水量，按水量降序取第一行即为水量最大的一天。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round((sum(h.blower_kw) / sum(h.inflow_m3h))::numeric, 4) AS 吨水曝气电耗_kWh, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 0) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT 2", "explanation": "统计本周各厂鼓风机耗电量与处理水量之比，按吨水曝气电耗升序取前两名。"}

{"sql":"SELECT p.name AS 厂站, h.hour AS 时间, round(h.cod_out::numeric, 2) AS 出水COD_mgL FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' AND h.cod_out IS NOT NULL ORDER BY h.cod_out DESC LIMIT 1","explanation":"查询过去7天各小时出水COD，按COD降序取最高的一条，显示厂站、时间和COD值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT count(*) AS 总磷超标小时数, count(DISTINCT h.plant_id) AS 涉及厂站数, round(max(h.tp_out_max)::numeric, 3) AS 最高总磷 FROM plant_reading_1h h WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) AND h.tp_out_max > 0.5", "explanation": "统计本周（自本周一 00:00 起）全区所有厂站小时均值数据中出水总磷最大值超过 0.5 mg/L 的小时总数，并附带涉及厂站数与最高值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE h.nh3n_out_max > 5) AS 氨氮超标小时数, round(max(h.nh3n_out_max)::numeric, 2) AS 氨氮小时最高值_mgL FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%黄官%' AND h.hour >= timestamp '2026-11-04 00:00:00+08' AND h.hour < timestamp '2026-11-05 00:00:00+08'", "explanation": "筛选黄官镇污水处理站 11 月 4 日全天的小时数据，统计出水氨氮最大值超过 5 mg/L 的小时数并取当日最高值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(h.tn_out)::numeric, 2) AS 平均出水总氮_mgL, round(max(h.tn_out)::numeric, 2) AS 最大小时均值_mgL, count(*) AS 统计小时数 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.code = 'P01' AND h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY p.name", "explanation": "从小时聚合表取中心厂最近7天出水总氮小时均值，计算平均值与最大值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, count(h.hour) FILTER (WHERE h.cod_out > 50 OR h.nh3n_out_max > 5 OR h.tn_out > 15 OR h.tp_out_max > 0.5 OR h.ss_out > 10) AS 不达标小时数 FROM plant p LEFT JOIN plant_reading_1h h ON h.plant_id = p.id AND h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id", "explanation": "以厂站为主表左连接昨天的小时均值数据，按一级A标准逐小时判断五项出水指标是否超标，统计各厂不达标小时数，无超标或数据的厂显示 0。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, d.model AS 型号, d.rated_kw AS 额定功率_kW, d.status AS 状态 FROM device d JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE d.kind = '鼓风机' AND d.status = '备用' ORDER BY d.code", "explanation": "从设备台账筛选类型为鼓风机且状态为备用的设备，关联厂站表显示所属厂站。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, round(max(r.vibration_mms)::numeric, 2) AS 最大振动_mm_s, to_char((array_agg(r.ts ORDER BY r.vibration_mms DESC))[1], 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS 出现时间
FROM device_reading r
JOIN device d ON d.id = r.device_id
JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id
WHERE d.kind = '鼓风机' AND r.ts >= now() - interval '7 days' AND r.vibration_mms IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.name, d.code
ORDER BY max(r.vibration_mms) DESC
LIMIT 1", "explanation": "统计最近7天各鼓风机的最大振动值，按最大值降序取第一台，并给出该峰值出现的时间。"}

{"sql": "SELECT h.hour AS 时间, p.name AS 厂站, round(h.tp_out_max::numeric, 3) AS 出水总磷最大值_mg_L FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' AND h.hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) AND h.hour < date_trunc('week', now()) + interval '7 days' AND h.tp_out_max > 0.5 ORDER BY h.hour ASC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "筛选协税镇本周内出水总磷小时最大值超过0.5的记录，按时间升序取最早一条。"}

{"sql": "SELECT d.code AS 设备编码, d.model AS 型号, round(avg(r.temp_c)::numeric, 1) AS 平均温度_摄氏度, round(max(r.temp_c)::numeric, 1) AS 最高温度_摄氏度 FROM device_reading r JOIN device d ON d.id = r.device_id JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE p.code = 'P01' AND d.kind = '鼓风机' AND r.running AND r.ts >= now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY d.code, d.model ORDER BY d.code", "explanation": "筛选中心厂（P01）鼓风机在最近24小时内运行状态下的监测记录，按设备统计平均和最高轴承温度。"}

{"sql": "SELECT d.code AS 设备编码, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.running = false) AS 停机分钟数 FROM device_reading r JOIN device d ON d.id = r.device_id JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%黄官%' AND d.kind = '鼓风机' AND d.code = 'P06-BL-1' AND r.ts >= timestamptz '2026-11-04 00:00:00+08' AND r.ts < timestamptz '2026-11-05 00:00:00+08' GROUP BY d.code", "explanation": "筛选黄官镇污水站 P06-BL-1 鼓风机在 11 月 4 日全天的分钟级监测记录，统计 running=false 的条数即为停机分钟数。"}

{"sql": "SELECT d.code AS 设备编码, round(avg(r.current_a)::numeric, 1) AS 平均电流_A
FROM device_reading r
JOIN device d ON d.id = r.device_id
JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id
WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND d.kind = '提升泵' AND r.running
  AND r.ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day'
  AND r.ts < date_trunc('day', now())
GROUP BY d.code
ORDER BY d.code", "explanation": "筛选中心厂提升泵在昨天自然日内运行时的监测记录，按设备编码分组求平均电流。"}

{"sql": "WITH t AS (SELECT sum(blower_kw) AS kwh, sum(inflow_m3h) AS m3 FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND hour < date_trunc('day', now())) SELECT round(kwh::numeric, 1) AS 鼓风机总耗电量_kWh, round(m3::numeric, 1) AS 处理水量_m3, round((kwh / NULLIF(m3, 0))::numeric, 4) AS 吨水曝气电耗_kWh每m3 FROM t;", "explanation": "统计昨天全天各厂站小时表鼓风机耗电量与处理水量之和，相除得到吨水电耗。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(sum(carbon_dose_kgh)::numeric, 1) AS 碳源投加量_kg, round(sum(pac_dose_kgh)::numeric, 1) AS PAC投加量_kg, count(DISTINCT plant_id) AS 涉及厂站数 FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) AND hour < now()", "explanation": "汇总本周（周一起至当前）全部厂站小时表中碳源与PAC的小时投加量，得到全区累计投加公斤数。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, round(avg(r.mlss)::numeric, 1) AS 平均污泥浓度_mgL, round(min(r.mlss)::numeric, 1) AS 最低值, round(max(r.mlss)::numeric, 1) AS 最高值 FROM plant_reading r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.ts >= now() - interval '7 days' AND r.mlss IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 平均污泥浓度_mgL DESC", "explanation": "MLSS 未收录于小时聚合表，故用原始表 plant_reading 统计最近 7 天各厂污泥浓度均值"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(r.air_flow_m3h)::numeric, 0) AS 平均曝气风量_m3h FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND r.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND r.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.name", "explanation": "筛选中心厂昨天全天的小时均值记录，对曝气总风量 air_flow_m3h 取平均。"}

{"sql": "SELECT to_char(hour AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai', 'MM-DD HH24:00') AS 时间, round(avg(r.tp_out)::numeric, 2) AS 出水总磷均值_mgL FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' AND r.hour >= timestamptz '2026-11-03 00:00:00+08' AND r.hour < timestamptz '2026-11-04 00:00:00+08' GROUP BY r.hour ORDER BY r.hour", "explanation": "按协税镇厂站筛选 11 月 3 日全天的小时均值数据，逐小时汇总出水总磷（tp_out）平均值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT to_char(hour, 'HH24:00') AS 小时, round(sum(inflow_m3h)::numeric, 0) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) AND hour < now() GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour", "explanation": "从小时聚合表按整点分组，汇总今日 0 点至当前的全厂站进水流量，即全区每小时处理水量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT date_trunc('day', r.hour)::date AS 日期, p.name AS 厂站, round(sum(r.blower_kw)::numeric, 1) AS 鼓风机耗电量_kWh, round(sum(r.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 0) AS 处理水量_m3, round((sum(r.blower_kw) / nullif(sum(r.inflow_m3h), 0))::numeric, 4) AS 吨水曝气电耗_kWh每m3 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.kind = '中心厂' AND r.hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) AND r.hour < now() GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1", "explanation": "取本周起至今中心厂的小时数据，按自然日汇总鼓风机耗电量与处理水量，两者相除得到每天的吨水曝气电耗。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, round(sum(r.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 0) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND r.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY sum(r.inflow_m3h) DESC LIMIT 3", "explanation": "按昨天自然日汇总各厂站 plant_reading_1h 的小时处理水量并取前三名。"}

{"sql":"SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, round(avg(r.cod_out)::numeric, 2) AS 平均出水COD FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY avg(r.cod_out) DESC LIMIT 1;","explanation":"查询最近7天各厂站小时均值表中出水COD的平均值，并按均值降序取最高的厂站。"}

{"sql":"SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS 日期, round(avg(temp_c)::numeric, 1) AS 平均气温 FROM weather WHERE ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '4 days' AND ts < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY 日期 ORDER BY 日期;","explanation":"按自然日统计 11 月 1 日至 4 日气象数据的平均气温。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, round(sum(r.carbon_dose_kgh)::numeric, 1) AS 碳源投加量_kg, round(sum(r.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 0) AS 处理水量_m3, round((sum(r.carbon_dose_kgh) / nullif(sum(r.inflow_m3h), 0))::numeric, 5) AS 吨水碳源投加量_kg_per_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' AND r.hour < date_trunc('hour', now()) GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY 吨水碳源投加量_kg_per_m3 DESC NULLS LAST", "explanation": "按厂站汇总最近7天（不含当前未完成小时）的碳源投加量与处理水量，两者相除得到吨水碳源投加量并降序排列。"}

{"sql": "SELECT date_trunc('day', hour)::date AS 日期, round(sum(inflow_m3h)::numeric, 0) AS 全区处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 7", "explanation": "按自然日汇总最近7天各厂站小时处理水量（sum(inflow_m3h)），按水量降序排列，第一行即为水量最大的一天。"}

{"sql":"SELECT p.name AS 厂站, h.hour AS 时间, round(h.cod_out::numeric, 2) AS 出水COD FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' AND h.cod_out IS NOT NULL ORDER BY h.cod_out DESC LIMIT 1","explanation":"查询过去7天各厂站小时均值数据，按出水COD降序取最高的一条并关联厂站名称。"}

{"sql":"SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, count(*) AS 超标小时数, round(max(h.nh3n_out_max)::numeric, 2) AS 最大氨氮_mgL, min(h.hour) AS 首次超标时间, max(h.hour) AS 最近超标时间 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' AND h.nh3n_out_max > 5 GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 超标小时数 DESC;","explanation":"统计最近7天内小时出水氨氮最大值超过一级A标准5 mg/L的厂站，并按超标小时数汇总。"}

{"sql":"SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(sum(r.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 0) AS 本周处理水量_m3, round(sum(r.blower_kw)::numeric, 1) AS 本周曝气耗电量_kWh, round((sum(r.blower_kw) / nullif(sum(r.inflow_m3h), 0))::numeric, 4) AS 吨水曝气电耗_kWh_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) AND r.hour <= now() GROUP BY p.id, p.name HAVING sum(r.inflow_m3h) > 0 ORDER BY (sum(r.blower_kw) / nullif(sum(r.inflow_m3h), 0)) ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 2;","explanation":"按本周小时数据汇总各厂处理水量和鼓风机耗电量，计算吨水曝气电耗并取最低的两个厂。"}

{"sql": "WITH t AS (
  SELECT pr.hour, pr.nh3n_out_max
  FROM plant_reading_1h pr
  JOIN plant p ON p.id = pr.plant_id
  WHERE p.name LIKE '%黄官%'
    AND pr.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day'
    AND pr.hour <  date_trunc('day', now())
)
SELECT p.name AS 厂站,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.nh3n_out_max > 5) AS 氨氮超标小时数,
       round(max(t.nh3n_out_max)::numeric, 2) AS 当日最高氨氮,
       round(max(t.nh3n_out_max) FILTER (WHERE t.nh3n_out_max > 5)::numeric, 2) AS 超标时段最高氨氮
FROM t
JOIN plant p ON p.name LIKE '%黄官%'
GROUP BY p.name;", "explanation": "取黄官镇污水站 11 月 4 日整天的逐小时数据，统计出水氨氮小时最大值超过一级A标准 5 mg/L 的小时数并给出当日及超标时段最高氨氮。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(r.tn_out)::numeric, 2) AS 平均出水总氮, round(max(r.tn_out)::numeric, 2) AS 最大小时均值总氮 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.kind = '中心厂' AND r.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' AND r.hour < date_trunc('hour', now()) GROUP BY p.name", "explanation": "取中心厂最近7天的小时均值数据，计算出水总氮的平均值和最大小时均值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, r.hour AS 本周首次总磷超标时间, round(r.tp_out_max::numeric, 2) AS 该小时总磷最大值 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' AND r.hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) AND r.hour <= now() AND r.tp_out_max > 0.5 ORDER BY r.hour LIMIT 1;", "explanation": "按本周时间范围筛选协税镇污水站小时数据，查找出水总磷最大值首次超过 0.5 mg/L 的小时。"}

{"sql":"SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, d.model AS 型号, round(max(dr.vibration_mms)::numeric, 2) AS 最大振动值, count(*) AS 采样点数, to_char(max(dr.ts) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS 出现时间 FROM device_reading dr JOIN device d ON d.id = dr.device_id JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE d.kind = '鼓风机' AND dr.ts >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY p.name, d.code, d.model ORDER BY 最大振动值 DESC LIMIT 5","explanation":"统计最近7天各鼓风机（device.kind='鼓风机'）的振动速度最大值，按降序取前几名以定位振动最大的鼓风机。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, d.code AS 设备编码, d.model AS 设备型号, d.rated_kw AS 额定功率_kW, d.installed_at AS 安装日期 FROM device d JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE d.kind = '鼓风机' AND d.status = '备用' ORDER BY p.code, d.code LIMIT 100", "explanation": "在设备台账中筛选类型为鼓风机且状态为备用的设备，关联厂站表输出所属厂站名称与设备信息。"}

{"sql":"WITH y AS (SELECT date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AS start_ts, date_trunc('day', now()) AS end_ts) SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, count(r.hour) FILTER (WHERE r.cod_out > 50 OR r.nh3n_out_max > 5 OR r.tn_out > 15 OR r.tp_out_max > 0.5 OR r.ss_out > 10) AS 不达标小时数 FROM plant p LEFT JOIN plant_reading_1h r ON r.plant_id = p.id AND r.hour >= (SELECT start_ts FROM y) AND r.hour < (SELECT end_ts FROM y) GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.name;","explanation":"按昨天自然日统计各厂小时均值表中出水 COD、氨氮最大值、总氮、总磷最大值、SS 超过一级 A 标准的小时数，并用左连接确保无超标厂也显示 0。"}

{"sql":"SELECT count(*) AS \"出水总磷超标小时数\" FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) AND hour <= now() AND tp_out_max > 0.5;","explanation":"统计本周各厂站小时均值表中出水总磷最大值超过一级A标准 0.5 mg/L 的厂站-小时记录数。"}

{"sql": "SELECT d.code AS 设备编码, round(avg(dr.current_a)::numeric, 2) AS 平均电流_安培, count(*) AS 运行采样点数 FROM device d JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id JOIN device_reading dr ON dr.device_id = d.id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND d.kind = '提升泵' AND dr.running = true AND dr.ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND dr.ts < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY d.code ORDER BY d.code", "explanation": "筛选中心厂提升泵设备，取昨天时间窗内运行状态（running=true）的监测记录，按设备分组计算平均电流。"}

{"sql":"SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, round(avg(dr.temp_c)::numeric, 2) AS 过去24小时平均温度
FROM plant p
JOIN device d ON d.plant_id = p.id
JOIN device_reading dr ON dr.device_id = d.id
WHERE p.kind = '中心厂'
  AND d.kind = '鼓风机'
  AND d.status = '运行'
  AND dr.ts >= now() - interval '24 hours'
GROUP BY p.name, d.code
ORDER BY d.code;","explanation":"筛选中心厂当前运行中的鼓风机，统计各设备过去24小时设备监测温度的平均值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, dr.ts AS 首次超标时间, round(dr.vibration_mms::numeric, 2) AS 振动值_mms FROM device_reading dr JOIN device d ON d.id = dr.device_id JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%黄官%' AND d.code = 'P06-BL-1' AND dr.ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND dr.ts < date_trunc('day', now()) AND dr.vibration_mms > 7.1 ORDER BY dr.ts LIMIT 1", "explanation": "在设备监测数据中筛选黄官镇污水站1号鼓风机（P06-BL-1）昨天（11月4日）振动值首次超过7.1 mm/s的记录，按时间升序取第一条。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, count(*) FILTER (WHERE dr.running IS FALSE) AS 停机分钟数 FROM device d JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id LEFT JOIN device_reading dr ON dr.device_id = d.id AND dr.ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND dr.ts < date_trunc('day', now()) WHERE p.name LIKE '%黄官%' AND d.kind = '鼓风机' AND d.code = p.code || '-BL-1' GROUP BY p.name, d.code;", "explanation": "按黄官镇污水站1号鼓风机（P06-BL-1）统计11月4日设备运行数据中 running=false 的每分钟记录数，即停机分钟数。"}

{"sql":"SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE dr.running) AS 污泥泵运行分钟数 FROM device d JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id JOIN device_reading dr ON dr.device_id = d.id WHERE d.kind = '污泥泵' AND dr.ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND dr.ts < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY p.name;","explanation":"按厂站关联污泥泵设备，统计昨天每个厂站污泥泵运行状态为运行的分钟数。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(rain_mm_h::numeric, 2) AS 最大降雨强度_毫米每小时, to_char(ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS 出现时间 FROM weather WHERE ts >= timestamptz '2026-10-31 00:00:00+08' AND ts < timestamptz '2026-11-01 00:00:00+08' AND rain_mm_h IS NOT NULL ORDER BY rain_mm_h DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "从气象表筛选 2026-10-31 全天数据，按降雨强度降序取最大值及其出现时间。"}

{"sql": "WITH r AS (SELECT ts, rain_mm_h FROM weather WHERE ts >= '2026-10-31 00:00:00+08' AND ts < '2026-11-01 00:00:00+08' AND rain_mm_h > 0) SELECT to_char(min(ts) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai', 'MM-DD HH24:MI') AS 降雨开始时间, to_char(max(ts) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai', 'MM-DD HH24:MI') AS 降雨结束时间, count(*) AS 降雨记录数, round(max(rain_mm_h)::numeric, 2) AS 最大降雨强度_毫米每小时, round(sum(rain_mm_h)::numeric, 2) AS 累计降雨量_毫米 FROM r", "explanation": "从气象表筛选 2026-10-31 全天降雨强度大于 0 的记录，取最早与最晚时刻作为降雨起止时间，并附带累计雨量与峰值强度。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(max(r.tp_out_max)::numeric, 2) AS 出水总磷最高值_mgL FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' AND r.hour >= '2026-11-03 00:00:00+08' AND r.hour < '2026-11-04 00:00:00+08' GROUP BY p.name", "explanation": "筛选协税镇厂站11月3日全天的小时数据，取出水总磷小时最大值中的最高值。"}

{"sql": "WITH daily AS (
  SELECT (pr.hour AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date AS day,
         sum(pr.inflow_m3h) AS water_m3
  FROM plant_reading_1h pr
  JOIN plant p ON p.id = pr.plant_id
  WHERE p.name LIKE '%梁山%'
    AND pr.hour >= timestamptz '2026-10-30 00:00:00+08'
    AND pr.hour < timestamptz '2026-11-01 00:00:00+08'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  round(max(CASE WHEN day = DATE '2026-10-31' THEN water_m3 END)::numeric, 0) AS "10月31日处理水量_m3",
  round(max(CASE WHEN day = DATE '2026-10-30' THEN water_m3 END)::numeric, 0) AS "10月30日处理水量_m3",
  round((max(CASE WHEN day = DATE '2026-10-31' THEN water_m3 END)
       - max(CASE WHEN day = DATE '2026-10-30' THEN water_m3 END))::numeric, 0) AS "较前一日增加_m3"
FROM daily;", "explanation": "按梁山镇厂站汇总10月30日和10月31日的小时处理水量，并计算两日总量差值。"}

{"sql":"WITH rain_days AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS day,
         max(rain_mm_h) AS max_rain
  FROM weather
  WHERE ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
    AND ts < now()
  GROUP BY 1
),
top_day AS (
  SELECT day, max_rain
  FROM rain_days
  ORDER BY max_rain DESC NULLS LAST
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT to_char(top_day.day, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "日期",
       round(top_day.max_rain::numeric, 2) AS "最大降雨强度(mm/h)",
       round(sum(pr.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 0) AS "全区处理水量(m³)"
FROM top_day
JOIN plant_reading_1h pr
  ON pr.hour >= top_day.day
 AND pr.hour < top_day.day + interval '1 day'
GROUP BY top_day.day, top_day.max_rain;","explanation":"先按自然日统计过去7天每日最大小时降雨强度并选出最大的一天，再汇总该日全区各厂站小时处理水量。"}

{"sql": "WITH d AS (SELECT COALESCE(sum(CASE WHEN hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND hour < date_trunc('day', now()) THEN inflow_m3h END), 0) AS yesterday_water, COALESCE(sum(CASE WHEN hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '2 days' AND hour < date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' THEN inflow_m3h END), 0) AS before_yesterday_water FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '2 days' AND hour < date_trunc('day', now())) SELECT round(yesterday_water::numeric, 2) AS \"昨日处理水量_m3\", round(before_yesterday_water::numeric, 2) AS \"前日处理水量_m3\", round((yesterday_water - before_yesterday_water)::numeric, 2) AS \"比前天增加_m3\" FROM d;", "explanation": "汇总全区所有厂站昨天与前天的每小时处理水量，并计算差值。"}

{"sql": "WITH t AS (SELECT p.kind, sum(r.inflow_m3h) AS vol FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY p.kind) SELECT round(sum(CASE WHEN kind = '中心厂' THEN vol ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 1) AS 中心厂处理水量, round(sum(vol)::numeric, 1) AS 全区处理水量, round((sum(CASE WHEN kind = '中心厂' THEN vol ELSE 0 END) / nullif(sum(vol), 0) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS 占比百分比 FROM t", "explanation": "统计最近7天各类型厂站小时处理水量之和，用中心厂水量除以全部厂站水量得到占比。"}

{"sql":"SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(min(least(r.do_aerobic_1, r.do_aerobic_2))::numeric, 2) AS 好氧区最低溶解氧_mgL FROM plant_reading r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%黄官%' AND r.ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' + interval '15 hours' AND r.ts < date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' + interval '18 hours';","explanation":"筛选黄官镇厂昨日15:00至18:00的原始监测数据，取两个好氧区溶解氧中的最小值作为故障期间最低溶解氧。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, round((avg(r.tn_in) - avg(r.tn_out)) / nullif(avg(r.tn_in), 0) * 100, 2) AS 总氮去除率百分比, round(avg(r.tn_in)::numeric, 2) AS 进水总氮均值, round(avg(r.tn_out)::numeric, 2) AS 出水总氮均值, count(*) AS 统计小时数 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' AND r.hour < now() AND r.tn_in IS NOT NULL AND r.tn_out IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY 总氮去除率百分比 DESC", "explanation": "取近7天各厂小时均值数据，用(进水总氮均值-出水总氮均值)/进水总氮均值计算总氮去除率并排序。"}
